Presidential Suites

The Presidential Suites redefine Caribbean luxury with dramatic interiors featuring dark, rich wood, sleek stainless‑steel accents, and meticulously crafted details designed to surround guests with comfort, sophistication, and effortless elegance. Every element has been intentionally curated to create one of the most relaxing, indulgent, and satisfying vacation experiences in Puerto Plata.

Offering a level of service and refinement that stands beyond compare, the Presidential Suites deliver a unique luxury accommodations experience within the world‑renowned Lifestyle Holidays Vacation Resort. Guests enjoy the easy, breezy ambiance of the Caribbean, elevated by an opulent atmosphere that blends modern design with warm tropical charm.

These beautifully appointed Studios, One‑Bedroom, and Two‑Bedroom Suites are designed for the most discerning travelers. Each suite features air‑conditioning, cable television, phones, and ceiling fans, while the décor showcases a distinctive modern aesthetic with cherry‑wood furnishings and polished stainless‑steel finishes. Shaded patios and verandas offer serene outdoor spaces perfect for morning coffee, sunset cocktails, or simply unwinding in the island breeze.

The One‑ and Two‑Bedroom Suites elevate the experience even further with fully equipped kitchens, premium stainless‑steel appliances, a separate dining area, a spacious living room, and a private balcony with spectacular views. Guests can spread out, relax, and enjoy all the comforts of home—enhanced by designer touches, luxurious materials, and the unforgettable beauty of the Caribbean coastline.

Indulge in Elevated Caribbean Luxury
Experience the Presidential Suites—where comfort, elegance, and unforgettable views come together

Our All-Inclusive Plan Includes:
  • Privileged use of all restaurants, bars, and facilities at the Resort (V.I.P areas and services exclusive for Members)

  • All meals – access to breakfast, lunch, and dinner in any of our restaurants on property (some restaurants require advance reservations)

  • 7 V.I.P exclusive restaurants

  • 9 All Guest restaurants for a la carte dining
    (Reservations may be required)

  • 2 International Buffet restaurants (No reservations required)

  • Daytime and late snacks located throughout the property, including 11 V.I.P Lite Fare Bars

  • Includes: House Wine with Meals, plus Beer, Spirits, Cocktails, Juices, and Soft Drinks are available from all Bars located on the property.
